title: クレーンゲーム大成功！

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: You're so cool, Trainer! You handled those controls like a pro!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Did you train somewhere? What school did you go to? What's your rank?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: I can't wait until the day your skills and spirit pass on to me!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: I'll follow you forever, so please take me under your wing! That's a super promise, okay?!
